title: Poocha asghar ke liye
body:
poocha asghar ke liye shah ne kya mangte hai
roke bano ne kaha aab e baqa mangte hai
poocha asghar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
hiddate dasht se muztar hai faqat saaye ko
jaane zehra ka ye daaman e khaba mangte hai
poocha asghar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
apne cheh maah ke bache ke liye aada se
pani ek boond shahe karbobala mangte hai
poocha asghar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
baksh de ummate jad tujhko mere khoon ki qasam
khaake paykaan ali asghar ye dua mangte hai
poocha asghar ke....
<<DIVIDER>>
ahlebayt e nabawi shaam ke bazaron may
sar chupane ke liye ek rida mangte hai
poocha asghar ke...
author: Anees Pehersari
